title: Useful to Whom? Sample Value Is Defined Only Relative to the Learner
abstract: arXiv:2610.00221v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: What kind of data does a model need in order to learn? Coreset selection makes this question concrete: under a budget, keep the samples most useful for training. Easy-first and geometric coverage criteria can win in different budget regimes, separated by a crossover boundary. We ask whether this boundary is fixed by the data or changes with the target learner. Controlled experiments freeze the selected subsets and manipulate only the training learner. On low-resolution ImageNet-100, doubling ResNet-18's width moves the crossover from 57 to 85 samples per class: the learner changes the relative value of the same samples. A wider sweep reveals an interaction between input grid and capacity. Enlarging the grid while retaining the same image information shifts the boundary left, and this shift weakens as width increases. translated_title: 对谁有用？样本价值只有相对于学习器才有意义
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.00221v1 通告类型：cross 摘要：一个模型需要什么样的数据才能学习？核心集选择（coreset selection）使这个问题变得具体：在预算约束下，保留对训练最有用的样本。“易样本优先”与“几何覆盖”两类准则在不同的预算区间内各有胜负，二者之间由一个交叉边界分隔。我们追问：这个边界是由数据本身固定，还是会随目标学习器而改变？受控实验冻结所选子集，仅改变训练所用的学习器。在低分辨率ImageNet-100上，将ResNet-18的宽度加倍会使交叉点从每类57个样本移动到85个样本：学习器改变了同一样本的相对价值。更大范围的扫描揭示了输入网格与模型容量之间的交互作用：在保留相同图像信息的前提下扩大输入网格会使边界左移，且这种偏移随宽度增大而减弱。步长控制实验在不改变输入网格的情况下再现并逆转了网格效应；仅移除最后一个下采样……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过冻结样本子集、只改变学习器的受控实验证明，核心集选择中“易样本优先”与“几何覆盖”准则之间的交叉边界并非由数据固定，而是随学习器容量（如ResNet-18宽度、输入网格分辨率）而移动，说明样本的价值只有相对于特定学习器才有意义。
en_tdlr: Through controlled experiments that freeze the selected subsets and vary only the learner, this paper shows that the crossover boundary between easy-first and geometric coverage coreset selection criteria is not fixed by the data but shifts with learner capacity, demonstrating that sample value is defined only relative to the learner.
